content:
Cedar Point’s HalloWeekends is now open, bringing haunted houses, roaming monsters and roller coasters after dark to the Sandusky, Ohio, park. The event runs on select days through Nov. 1.

New this year is Diablo: The Infernal Path, a haunted maze that brings demons from the video game series face to face with visitors. Crystal Rock Massacre adds a summer-camp horror setting to the outdoor scare zones, joining Cut Throat Cove, Clownz and Tombstone Terrortory.

Returning haunts include Midnight, Slaughter House, The Haunting of Eerie Estate, Fearground Freak Show and CornStalkers 2.0. The Conjuring: Beyond Fear also returns, putting visitors in the role of paranormal investigators.

Several rides get Halloween makeovers, including GateKeeper as GateKreeper, Rougarou as RougaBOO! and Maverick as MaverEEK! Live music, acrobatics, storytelling and a wedding-themed murder mystery add to the entertainment.

Families can visit during the day for trick-or-treating, pumpkin picking and decorating, crafts, hay and corn mazes, a kids’ costume contest and a Snoopy Halloween show. Seasonal food includes burgers, wings and Detroit-style pizza, with new pumpkin whoopie pies, s’mores parfaits and Halloween mocktails also on the menu.
